description: This file contains unit test structures and functions for testing the behavior of GatewayConnection's mainSessionKey extraction logic using JSON configuration data.

classes.name: WebChatMainSessionKeyTests
classes.description: A collection of test functions to verify the correctness of main session key extraction logic from JSON configurations.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back to main when missing
methods.description: Tests that the main session key defaults to 'main' when the key is missing from the config.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key trims and uses value
methods.description: Tests that the main session key is correctly trimmed and used when present in the config.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when empty or whitespace
methods.description: Tests fallback to 'main' when the mainKey value is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: config get snapshot main key falls back when config null
methods.description: Tests fallback to 'main' when the config is null.

methods.name: config get snapshot uses global scope
methods.description: Tests that the main session key is 'global' when specified in the config scope.
